entry.title: Why I'm making Faraday
entry.summary: How a hardware wallet's entropy bug led from an offline HTML file, through Tails and a stripped-down Arch, to one Rust program on a bare Linux kernel.

entry.title: Faraday's first audit
entry.summary: The first outside audit of Faraday found two critical and five high issues; what they were, how each was fixed, and what an audit means for a project like this one.
